description: List the store's discount coupons with optional filters (coupon code, discount type, availability). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /discount_coupons.

availability.description: Filter by availability, e.g. ACTIVE | PAUSED | EXPIRED | COMPLETE.

discount_type.description: Filter by discount type, e.g. ABS | PERCENT | SHIPPING | ABS_AND_SHIPPING | PERCENT_AND_SHIPPING.

name: ecwid_list_discount_coupons
title: List discount coupons
